title: Alphawaves dataset
description: The Alphawaves dataset comprises resting-state EEG recordings from 19 healthy participants acquired using a 16-channel g.tec g.USBamp system at 512 Hz sampling rate. Participants alternated between eyes-closed and eyes-open conditions in 10-second trials, with event-related synchronization analysis focused on alpha frequency band activity (8-12 Hz). This dataset serves as a benchmark resource for brain-computer interface research and resting-state EEG analysis.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 19 healthy subjects using a 16-channel g.tec g.USBamp amplifier with wet electrodes in a standard 10-10 montage, sampled at 512 Hz with right earlobe reference. Subjects performed alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open resting-state conditions, each lasting 10 seconds. Data were recorded using OpenViBE software with 50 Hz line frequency and no online digital filtering applied.
